newsitem.title: USA: Medical Resources hires Coopers Lybrand.
newsitem.headline: Medical Resources hires Coopers Lybrand.

text.p: Medical Resources Inc said it has hired Coopers & Lybrand LLP as its outside accounting firm, replacing Ernst & Young LLP.
Medical Resources, which operates diagnostic imaging centers, said that the change of auditing firms was due to the relocation of its accouting and finance staffs to New Jersey from Florida.

The imaging business expertise of Coopers & Lybrand's New Jersey office makes them an ideal selection for our needs," said William William Farrell, Medical Resources' president and chief operating officer.
Coopers and Lybrand provided, for over 12 years, accounting and auditing services for NMR of America, with which Medical Resources merged in August.
